latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Photo Video Maker Hindi — turn your photos into Hindi-captioned slideshow videos.

- Create slideshow videos from JPG, PNG, HEIC, and MP3 files (up to 200MB).
- Export 1080p MP4 videos, ideal for Hindi-speaking social media creators.
- Automatic connection to cloud processing backend; 100 free credits with anonymous use.
- Supports photo upload, adding background music, Hindi text captions, and quick cloud rendering (1–2 minutes).
- Includes easy file upload, project session management, and clear status/progress messages.
- User-friendly error handling with tips and supported file formats.
